label: Java
headline: Java Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for Java — data types, strings, arrays, loops, collections, classes, exception handling, and more.

items.name: Hello World
items.definition: Every Java program needs a class with a main method as its entry point.

items.name: Print
items.definition: Prints a line to the console. Use print() to omit the newline, or printf() for formatted output.

items.name: Comments
items.definition: Three comment styles: single-line (//), block (/* */), and Javadoc (/** */) for documentation.

items.name: Import
items.definition: Import a class from a package to use it without its fully qualified name.

items.name: int
items.definition: 32-bit signed integer. Range: -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647. Default: 0.

items.name: long
items.definition: 64-bit signed integer. Suffix L for literals. Use when int is too small.

items.name: double
items.definition: 64-bit floating-point. Default choice for decimals. Default: 0.0.

items.name: float
items.definition: 32-bit floating-point. Suffix f for literals. Less precise than double.

items.name: boolean
items.definition: true or false only. Default: false.

items.name: char
items.definition: Single 16-bit Unicode character. Use single quotes.

items.name: byte
items.definition: 8-bit signed integer. Range: -128 to 127. Default: 0.

items.name: short
items.definition: 16-bit signed integer. Range: -32,768 to 32,767. Default: 0.

items.name: Declare & assign
items.definition: Declare a variable with a type, name, and value in one statement.

items.name: Widening cast
items.definition: Automatically converts a smaller type to a larger type. No data loss.

items.name: Narrowing cast
items.definition: Explicitly convert a larger type to a smaller type. May lose data (9.99 → 9).

items.name: String → int
items.definition: Parse a String to an int. Throws NumberFormatException if the string is not a valid integer.

items.name: String → double
items.definition: Parse a String to a double.

items.name: int → String
items.definition: Convert any primitive to a String using String.valueOf().

items.name: var (Java 10+)
items.definition: Local variable type inference — the compiler infers the type from the right-hand side.

items.name: Create
items.syntax:
String s = "Hello";
String s2 = new String("Hello");
items.definition: String literals are preferred — they are cached in the string pool.

items.name: Concatenate
items.definition: Use + to join strings. Numbers are automatically converted to strings.

items.name: Length
items.definition: Returns the number of characters in the string.

items.name: charAt()
items.definition: Returns the character at the given index (zero-based).

items.name: indexOf()
items.definition: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a substring, or -1 if not found.

items.name: substring()
items.definition: Extracts characters from start index (inclusive) to end index (exclusive).

items.name: toUpperCase()
items.definition: Returns a new string with all characters converted to uppercase.

items.name: toLowerCase()
items.definition: Returns a new string with all characters converted to lowercase.

items.name: trim()
items.definition: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from the string.

items.name: replace()
items.definition: Returns a new string with all occurrences of the first argument replaced by the second.

items.name: contains()
items.definition: Returns true if the string contains the specified sequence of characters.

items.name: startsWith()
items.definition: Returns true if the string begins with the specified prefix.

items.name: endsWith()
items.definition: Returns true if the string ends with the specified suffix.

items.name: equals()
items.definition: Compares two strings by value. Use equals() not == for string comparison.

items.name: isEmpty()
items.definition: Returns true if the string has length zero.

items.name: split()
items.definition: Splits the string around matches of the given regex and returns a String array.

items.name: StringBuilder
items.definition: Mutable string builder — use instead of concatenating with + in loops for better performance.

items.name: Declare & init
items.definition: Declare and initialize an array with literal values.

items.name: Declare with size
items.definition: Create an array of a fixed size. Elements default to null (objects) or 0 (primitives).

items.name: Access element
items.definition: Access element at index 0. Arrays are zero-indexed.

items.name: Length
items.definition: The .length property (not a method) returns the number of elements.

items.name: Sort
items.definition: Sorts the array in ascending order in-place. Import java.util.Arrays.

items.name: To string
items.definition: Returns a readable string representation like [1, 2, 3].

items.name: 2D array
items.definition: Declare a 2D array with nested initializers.

items.name: 2D access
items.definition: Access the element at row 0, column 1.

items.name: Arithmetic
items.definition: Add, subtract, multiply, divide, and modulus (remainder).

items.name: Increment
items.definition: Post-increment (i++) returns current value then adds 1. Pre-increment (++i) adds 1 first.

items.name: Decrement
items.definition: Post-decrement returns current value then subtracts 1. Pre-decrement subtracts 1 first.

items.name: Comparison
items.definition: Compare two values. Return a boolean. Use .equals() for object comparison.

items.name: Logical
items.definition: AND (&&), OR (||), NOT (!). Short-circuit — the right side isn't evaluated if the result is determined by the left.

items.name: Assignment
items.definition: Compound assignment operators. x += 5 is shorthand for x = x + 5.

items.name: Ternary
items.definition: Shorthand if/else. condition ? valueIfTrue : valueIfFalse.

items.name: instanceof
items.definition: Returns true if obj is an instance of String (or a subclass/interface).

items.name: Bitwise
items.definition: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, left-shift, right-shift — operate on individual bits.

items.name: if / else if / else
items.definition: Standard conditional branching. Only one branch executes.

items.name: switch
items.definition: Matches a value against cases. Always include break to prevent fall-through. default is optional.

items.name: switch expression (Java 14+)
items.definition: Arrow syntax returns a value directly. No break needed.

items.name: for loop
items.definition: Classic counted loop with init, condition, and update expressions.

items.name: enhanced for (for-each)
items.definition: Iterate over arrays or collections without index management.

items.name: while loop
items.definition: Repeats while the condition is true. May not execute at all if condition is false initially.

items.name: do-while loop
items.definition: Like while, but the body always executes at least once before the condition is checked.

items.name: break
items.definition: Immediately exits the loop body.

items.name: continue
items.definition: Skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next.

items.name: ArrayList
items.definition: Ordered, resizable list backed by an array. Fast random access but slow inserts/removes in the middle.

items.name: HashMap
items.definition: Key-value store with O(1) average lookup. Unordered. Keys and values must be objects.

items.name: HashSet
items.definition: Unordered collection of unique values. O(1) average add/contains/remove.

items.name: LinkedList
items.definition: Doubly-linked list. Use as a Queue (FIFO) or Deque. Slow random access.

items.name: ArrayDeque
items.definition: Resizable array-based deque. Use as a Stack (LIFO) or Queue. Generally faster than LinkedList.

items.name: Iterate map
items.definition: Iterate all key/value pairs using forEach with a lambda.

items.name: Collections.sort()
items.definition: Sort a List in natural order. Pass a Comparator for custom ordering.

items.name: Class definition
items.definition: A class is a blueprint. The constructor initializes a new object instance.

items.name: Create object
items.definition: Instantiate a class with new and call its constructor.

items.name: this keyword
items.definition: Refers to the current object instance. Used to distinguish fields from constructor/method parameters.

items.name: Inheritance
items.definition: extends sets the parent class. super() calls the parent constructor.

items.name: Interface
items.syntax:
interface Swimmable { void swim(); }
class Duck extends Animal implements Swimmable { ... }
items.definition: Interfaces define a contract of methods a class must implement. A class can implement multiple interfaces.

items.name: Static method
items.syntax: public static int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
items.definition: Belongs to the class, not an instance. Call as ClassName.method() without creating an object.

items.name: Getter / Setter
items.syntax:
public String getName() { return name; }
public void setName(String name) { this.name = name; }
items.definition: Encapsulate private fields with public accessor and mutator methods.

items.name: try / catch / finally
items.definition: try wraps risky code, catch handles specific exceptions, finally always executes (cleanup).

items.name: throws declaration
items.definition: Declares that a method may throw a checked exception — callers must handle or rethrow it.

items.name: throw
items.definition: Explicitly throw an exception. Use custom messages to aid debugging.

items.name: Common exceptions
items.syntax:
NullPointerException
ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
ClassCastException
NumberFormatException
IllegalArgumentException
IOException
items.definition: Frequently encountered Java exceptions. RuntimeExceptions are unchecked; IOException requires handling.

items.name: public
items.definition: Accessible from any class in any package.

items.name: protected
items.definition: Accessible within the same package and by subclasses in other packages.

items.name: default (package-private)
items.definition: No modifier — accessible only within the same package.

items.name: private
items.definition: Accessible only within the declaring class. Used for encapsulation.

items.name: final
items.definition: Variable: cannot be reassigned. Method: cannot be overridden. Class: cannot be extended.

items.name: static
items.definition: Belongs to the class rather than any instance. Shared across all objects.

items.name: max() / min()
items.definition: Return the larger or smaller of two values.

items.name: abs()
items.definition: Returns the absolute (non-negative) value.

items.name: pow()
items.definition: Returns the first argument raised to the power of the second.

items.name: sqrt()
items.definition: Returns the positive square root.

items.name: round()
items.definition: Rounds to the nearest integer.

items.name: random()
items.definition: Returns a random double in [0, 1). Multiply and cast to get integers: (int)(Math.random() * 10).

items.name: floor() / ceil()
items.definition: floor() rounds down; ceil() rounds up.

items.name: Scanner setup
items.syntax:
import java.util.Scanner;
Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
items.definition: Import Scanner and create an instance connected to standard input.

items.name: Read string
items.definition: Reads a full line of input as a String.

items.name: Read int
items.definition: Reads the next token as an integer. Throws InputMismatchException for non-integers.

items.name: Read double
items.definition: Reads the next token as a double.

items.name: Close scanner
items.definition: Release the scanner resource when done reading input.
